top_choice_rationale: P001 rewards the experimental realisation of Hubbard models with ultracold atoms in optical lattices (Mott transition, fermionic Hubbard physics, single-site-resolved microscopy): two decades of reproduction across many laboratories, quantitative agreement with theory, and a genuinely new regime in which correlations are imaged atom by atom. The three-experimentalist allocation matches the observations the citation names, though the credit is imperfect (Zoller, Cirac, Jaksch outside it). P003 (lattice clocks) is cleaner on attribution but is closer to a measurement capability than a discovery about nature; P002 is attractive but still young with an open pairing mechanism.
recusal_note: No direct conflict with the laureates in the slate; as WACQT director and a superconducting-circuit theorist I have field proximity to cold-atom and quantum-simulation work only indirectly, so none apparent from profile.
